title: Give a user a persistent way to choose the default engine
details:
The engine default is derived from the host: Firecracker on x86_64 Linux with a usable `/dev/kvm`, and Podman everywhere else (`internal/cli/create.go:25`). Open question 1 in SPEC.md §17 asks whether a user-level default should override that, and where it would be configured.

There is a real reason to want one. A developer on a KVM host who is debugging a container-engine behaviour, or who wants the faster create path, currently repeats `--engine podman` on every command that creates something.

Half the mechanism already exists and is undocumented: `--engine` defaults from `CS_SANDBOX_ENGINE`. The open question is really whether that is the whole answer, or whether the tool should grow a config file for it.

An environment variable is the cheaper answer and fits a tool that keeps no host-wide config today. Documenting it and saying so in the spec would close the question without new code.
